# netactuate_nke_worker_private_ips (Data Source)

Maps each worker node of an NKE cluster in a VPC to its private IP, for load balancer backends. The cluster must be in a VPC that the API key's account owns. The read waits, within timeouts { read }, until at least the cluster's minimum number of workers have an address, and while workers above the maximum are being removed, so it returns the new set of workers in the same apply as a node count change.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_nke_worker_private_ips" "example" {
  cluster_id = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (Number) The ID of the NKE cluster. The cluster must be in a VPC that the API key's account owns

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `private_ips` (Map of String) Worker node name to private IP in the cluster's VPC, for each worker that has one

- `read` (String)
